newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's VTR denies CTC merger a done deal.
newsitem.headline: Chile's VTR denies CTC merger a done deal.

text.p: Chilean long distance company VTR said its talks for a possible merger with Compania de Telecomunicaciones de Chile continued, denying reported statements by CTC President Claudio Garcia.
"The situation between VTR and CTC has not varied in recent weeks and both parties continue to carry out efforts to reach an agreement," a VTR statement said.

CTC, 44-percent owned by Telefonica de Espana, and its long distance rival VTR, owned by the Luksic group, have been in talks toward a possible merger for several months. Garcia told reporters Tuesday that an agreement had been reached.

"I imagine that there has been an erroneous interpretation of some statement by Claudio Garcia, since the situation in negotiations has not varied substantially during the last few weeks," VTR Executive Director Blas Tomic said in a statement.
"This is why we are committed to not giving out information on the negotiations in progress until there is a definitive agreement," the statement quoted Tomic as saying.
